decisions.reason: An interpreted project has no compile step, so the equivalent question is whether the pinned environment installs and the suite passes. The check becomes a locked install plus the platform matrix.

The risk it guards, silently requiring something newer than the declared minimum, exists here in a different form. The check becomes a matrix leg on the oldest supported interpreter and the oldest dependency versions the manifest admits.

A release of this is a wheel and a source distribution rather than a plugin archive, so the check builds those. The plugin repository manifest the same job family generates there has no counterpart and is recorded beside this set as not applicable.
The bill of materials is the same artefact over a different dependency graph, and the resolved graph here is what a reproduced result depends on.
Same check, different language pack. The compiled language is replaced by Python.
The analysis job of the same product, named for the language it analyses. It becomes the Python job and its name moves with it.
The failure it refuses is identical here. A commit with no sign-off trailer is refused, and what the trailer asserts waits on the license question.
The shape is kept and the co-change rules are different, because the artefacts that must move together here are a transform and its profiles, and a manifest schema and its version.
The mechanism is kept and the invariants are this board's own.
A bidirectional control character makes source read as its own opposite in any language. The check transfers unchanged.
The workflows here are the same artefact with the same failure modes, so the audit transfers unchanged.
Unreadable diffs cost the same in any language. The source half becomes the formatter of this language and the documentation half needs a markdown formatter, which is not in force yet.
A newly introduced dependency carrying a known vulnerability is the same failure here, and the license question makes what enters the graph matter more rather than less.

not_applicable.name: the plugin package and its repository manifest
not_applicable.reason: Nothing here is installed into a host application, so there is no archive to build for one and no manifest for it to be listed in.

not_applicable.name: the end to end login check
not_applicable.reason: There is no login. What it does, proving the whole thing works from outside, is taken here by the worked example in the release milestone.

no_counterpart_there.name: a recorded run reproduces to the same scores
no_counterpart_there.reason: A published number that cannot be re-run is the situation this project argues against, and nothing on the target board protects a number.

no_counterpart_there.name: a parameter that is not in the manifest cannot reach the pipeline
no_counterpart_there.reason: A step reading a constant out of its own source cannot be swept, and a sweep that misses a parameter reports a stability the pipeline does not have.

no_counterpart_there.name: no output states a conclusion
no_counterpart_there.reason: A tool that prints an identification will be read as an authority whether or not it claims to be one.

no_counterpart_there.name: no test in the gate touches a display, a network or an administrator
no_counterpart_there.reason: A suite needing any of the three is skipped, prompted or failed on the restricted machines this project is aimed at, and a skipped suite reports the same green as one that ran.

not_required_there.name: mutation testing
not_required_there.reason: Present on the target board without holding a merge. A suite that passes over a changed number says nothing about whether it would notice one.

not_required_there.name: fuzzing the container reader
not_required_there.reason: Present on the target board without holding a merge. The parser of an untrusted container is where this project is attackable.

check_names.name: zizmor
check_names.source: code scanning, from the SARIF the workflow audit uploads under that category
check_names.conditional: The upload step is skipped where the token cannot write security events, which is a fork pull request and a Dependabot one. On those the check run is absent and the workflow audit still refuses findings.
